sentences.text: Heard on I.A. No.1394 of 2023 an application for condonation of delay.
There is delay of 1113 days in filing of this appeal.

The prayer is heavily opposed by learned counsel for respondent and he submits that under the provision of Right to Fair Compensation Act, this court is not empowered to condone the delay, even if good cause is shown.

Learned counsel for respondent has relied on the order dated 19.2.2025 in the case of State of M.P.
and others Vs. Rahul in which Hon'ble Coordinate bench has not condoned the delay of 157 and has dismissed the application for condonation of delay.

sentences.text: 1 Heard on admission.
The appeal is admitted for final hearing but no stay is being granted.
It is directed that entire amount, i.e. the amount awarded by the Land Acquisition Officer plus the amount enhanced by the Reference Court be deposited within four weeks from today.
The amount enhanced by the Reference court shall not be disbursed to other party without the leave of this court and shall be kept in FDR in a nationalized bank.
It is made clear that if the amount is not deposited within four weeks from today, then learned Execution Court shall be at liberty to execute the award.
Record is already received.
List for final hearing after four weeks.
C.c. today to both the parties.

opennyai_summary.arguments: The prayer is heavily opposed by learned counsel for respondent and he submits that under the provision of Right to Fair Compensation Act, this court is not empowered to condone the delay, even if good cause is shown.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
In the case of State of Kerala represented by District Collector, Kottayam and another Vs. Kool Foam Pvt. Ltd., Hon'ble Division Bench has refused to condone the delay in the matter relating to Section 74 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation &
Resettlement Act, 2013.
Same view has been taken by the Bombay High Court in the case of Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai Vs. Anusaya Sitaram 2 FA-241-2023 Devrukhkar and others in First Appeal (ST) No.24058 of 2024 and other connected matters vide order dated January, 07, 2025.

It is made clear that if the amount is not deposited within four weeks from today, then learned Execution Court shall be at liberty to execute the award.
Record is already received.
List for final hearing after four weeks.
